description: Under the title "Two Odd Numbers Make Pairs", an addition equation is shown with blue dots. On the left, seven dots form three vertical pairs plus one lone dot labeled "extra dot", above an encircled "7". After a "+" sign, three dots form one pair and one lone dot labeled "extra dot", above an encircled "3". Circled numbers appear beside each row: "16", "9", and "20", and below each column: "13", "17", and "15". Orange borders outline the top row and the left column. Beneath the grid, two blue rounded boxes display the addition sentences "4 + 7 + 5 = 16" and "4 + 6 + 3 = 13".

Three horizontal arrows point right, three vertical arrows point downward, and two diagonal arrows pass through the center cell toward the top corners. To the right, a second panel displays five stacked pill-shaped badges reading 'row', 'column', 'diagonal', 'magic sum', and '45 ÷ 3 = 15'.

The left grid has rows "8", "1", "6", then "3", "5", "7", then "4", "9", "2", with badges "1 to 9" and "magic sum 15" below. An orange arrow labelled "add 1 to every number" points to the right grid, which has rows "9", "2", "7", then "4", "6", "8", then "5", "10", "3", with badges "2 to 10" and "magic sum 18" below. Two green badges beneath read "each line gains 3" and "15 + 3 = 18".

The left panel shows a three-by-three grid containing rows "8", "1", "6"; "3", "5", "7"; and "4", "9", "2", with a caption below reading "m stands for the centre, 5". From left to right, the right-aligned additions show 'Y Y' plus 'Z' totalling 'Z O O', 'B 5' plus '3 D' totalling 'E D 5', 'K P' plus 'K P' totalling 'P R R', 'C 1' plus 'C' totalling '1 F F', and 'U T' plus 'T A' totalling 'T A T'.
